title: ever TIDAL|Embroidered Mesh Double V Neck Midi Mother of the Bride Dress
descriptionHtml:
This stunning midi dress combines elegance with a touch of romance. The embroidered mesh adds intricate detailing, while the double V-neck design flatters the neckline and enhances the silhouette. Perfect for mothers of the bride, this dress offers a graceful and sophisticated look for any formal occasion.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises mesh.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
